name: Urgent Care
title: Same-Day Urgent Care in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Same-day and next-day urgent care in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD. Infections, minor fractures, stitches, sprains, flu, and more, without the ER wait.
lede: When something comes up, call the office. Dr. Khan offers same-day and next-day appointments so a small problem gets treated before it becomes a bigger one, by a doctor who already knows your history.
glance: Quick treatment for illness and minor injuries, from your own doctor.

signs.heading: What we treat
signs.intro: Not sure if it can wait, or if it needs the ER? Call us and we will help you decide.

basics.heading: When to go to the ER instead
paras: For non-emergency problems, an office visit can mean less waiting and lower costs than an emergency room visit, while keeping your care with the doctor who manages the rest of your health.

Some situations need an emergency room right away. Call 911 for a compound fracture (bone through the skin), seizures, loss of consciousness, heavy bleeding, severe burns, a serious head or neck injury, or poisoning.

options.name: Heart attack signs
options.text: Chest pain or pressure, shortness of breath, arm, shoulder, back, or jaw pain, nausea, or light-headedness. Women more often feel back or jaw pain.

options.name: Stroke signs: think FAST
options.text: Face drooping or numb on one side, Arm weakness or numbness, Speech slurred or hard to understand, Time to call 911.

steps.heading: Same-day care in three steps
items: Tell us what is going on. We fit you in the same day or the next.
Exam, diagnosis, and treatment, with stitches, splints, or prescriptions as needed.
Dr. Khan checks in and adjusts care, since he is also your primary doctor.

faq: Do I need to be a member for urgent care?
No. Members get priority same-day or next-day appointments, but any patient can call for an urgent visit.
Can you do stitches in the office?
Yes. Wounds that need sutures are treated in the office.
What if it happens on the weekend?
Weekend visits are available by appointment. For a medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

next.heading: Call now. Be seen soon.
next.para: Most urgent problems can be seen the same day or the next. Call the office and tell us what is going on.
